reader_summary.headline: Amy Falls is the CIO at Northwestern University.
reader_summary.overview: Amy Falls is the CIO at Northwestern University. She also serves on the Board of Harvard Management Company, the Ford Foundation, Phillips Academy, and the Pete Peterson Foundation. Our conversation covers Amy's background and path to Northwestern, frameworks she learned along the way, and different challenges she faced in three different CIO seats.

key_points.text: Amy Falls is the CIO at Northwestern University.
We then turn to her thoughts on manager selection, liquidity, and across asset classes, covering fixed income, private credit, private equity, public equity.
We close with Amy's insights from her experience working with investment committees and parallels between her passion for farming and investing.
